unsupported: The combination of plate burning, machining, and finishing under one roof is intended to reduce lead times and coordinate quality control across operations.

Projects shown in its gallery include structural frames, base plates, and machined components for industrial equipment builders and OEMs in sectors such as heavy machinery, energy, and transportation.
The firm emphasizes that consolidating fabrication, machining, inspection, and coating into one workflow eliminates handoffs between vendors and shortens overall project schedules.
Employee ownership, adopted in 2022, is presented as a further alignment of workforce incentives with on-time delivery and part quality.
